phases.goal: Calibrate evidence, privacy, referral and consultation policy before releasing advice.
phases.exitGate: Adjudicated test cases; named review owners; source and claim templates accepted.

phases.goal: Hair/scalp foundations then barbering, beard, shaving, skin and body practice.
phases.exitGate: Foundation and Mastery dossiers reviewed, inclusive consultation cases pass, safety boundaries tested.

phases.goal: Ingredient dossiers, formula science, product categories, soap and fragrance.
phases.exitGate: Identity-specific dossiers and formulation applicability reviewed; no ingredient-to-product efficacy transfer.

phases.goal: Product development, jurisdiction-specific claims and reviewed catalog mapping.
phases.exitGate: Product Studio remains a distinct approval workflow; reviewed mapping and manufacturer evidence required.

phases.goal: Run heritage research alongside later phases with cultural-source specialists.
phases.exitGate: Primary provenance, permissions and cultural attribution reviewed; no traditional-practice medical claims.

phases.goal: Frontier surveillance and advanced evidence synthesis.
phases.exitGate: Human/preclinical distinctions, contrary evidence and short review cycles enforced.
